# reloved

> Mumbai's Digital Wall of Kindness — drop quality preloved clothes, shoes and bags, or claim them for free. No money. No judgement.

## Site

- Home: https://reloved.digital/
- Wall (browse & claim): https://reloved.digital/drop
- Drop an item: https://reloved.digital/give
- Wall of Love: https://reloved.digital/love
- Kindness map: https://reloved.digital/map
- About: https://reloved.digital/about
- FAQ: https://reloved.digital/faq
- Partners: https://reloved.digital/partner
- Contact: https://reloved.digital/contact
- Privacy: https://reloved.digital/privacy
- Terms: https://reloved.digital/terms

## Product language (use these terms)

- **Drop** — list a preloved item on the Wall (not “donate” / “give” / “donor” in user copy)
- **Claim** — request an item from the Wall
- **Reloved** — handover complete; both sides confirmed
- **Wall of Kindness** — the public listing of free preloved pieces in Mumbai

## What it is

reloved is a free circular-fashion platform in Mumbai. People drop clothing, footwear and bags they no longer need. Others claim them. Handover can be peer-to-peer or courier-assisted. Everything on the Wall is ₹0.

## What it is not

- Not a marketplace or resale app
- Not a paid thrift store
- Admin / account / partner dashboards are private (disallowed in robots.txt)

## Preferred citation

reloved — https://reloved.digital/ — “Preloved for free. Drop · Claim · Reloved.”
